svg.title: Disposal is not conviction
svg.desc: Conviction rates shown in the report range from 0.12 percent to 3.66 percent. The CEDAW figure of 53.52 percent is a disposal figure only, not a conviction rate, and must not be read as like-for-like with conviction rates.
svg.text: CEDAW disposal, NOT a conviction rate: 53.52%
Do not compare these two bars as if they measured the same thing.
